reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: plasma nitriding of Ti alloys at ~450°C is known to form a TiN layer that increases hardness and wear resistance, and the proposed mechanism (N diffusion, TiN formation, dislocation pinning) is well-established.
reasons.testability: The test is clear and decisive: nanoindentation and pin-on-disk wear tests with a >10% improvement threshold, plus SEM/TEM confirmation of the TiN layer, would cleanly falsify the hypothesis if not met.
reasons.usefulness: This is a standard, well-documented surface engineering approach for Ti alloys; while correctly formulated, it offers little novelty and would not advance the field beyond confirming known outcomes.
